name: lastfm
description: Installs a LastFM / ListenBrainz scrobbler which uses the Volumio artist and track info.
author: Saiyato

volumio_info.changelog: Scrobbling to ListenBrainz, alone or together with Last.fm (choose "Scrobbling service" in the settings). New installations default to ListenBrainz; existing installations keep scrobbling to Last.fm.
